purpose: Audit the algorithmic task generators for remaining leakage, trivial shortcuts, split contamination, or invalid claims. Give up to five concrete findings with severity and cheapest discriminating control. The model is a zero-boundary symmetric radius-one NCA with no diffusion; all input tokens are visible at tick zero and scored only where mask=1. Distinguish intended retrieval from answer leakage. Legacy Text/Dyck are excluded from clean experiments.
name: task-attack
